cases.name: direct resume
cases.source:
Public Sub Inner()
    Err.Raise 5
End Sub
Public Sub Fine()
End Sub
Public Sub Divide()
    Dim x As Double
    x = 1 / 0
End Sub
Public Function Twice(ByVal n As Long) As Long
    If n < 0 Then Err.Raise 6
    Twice = 2 * n
End Function
Public Sub Handled()
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Raise 5
End Sub
Public Sub Deeper()
    Err.Raise 7
End Sub
Public Sub Outer()
    On Error GoTo h
    Deeper
    Exit Sub
h:
End Sub
Public Sub Unhandled()
    Deeper
End Sub
Public Sub Custom()
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "Probe", "custom"
End Sub
Public Sub InHandler()
    On Error GoTo h
    Err.Raise 5
    Exit Sub
h:
    Err.Raise 9
End Sub
Function Probe() As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Inner
    Probe = "after " & Err.Number
End Function
